resources.string: All videos are recognised as films or episodes
Organise into Movies and Series folders
Moving files needs Android 11 or newer.
There is nothing to organise. Only recognised films and episodes in the Movies or Download folder are moved.

Telos will move %1$d films into Movies/Movies/Title (Year) and %2$d episodes into Movies/Series/Show/Season NN. Files are only moved, never deleted or changed, and watch progress is kept. Subtitle files next to the videos are not moved. Android will ask once more for permission to change these files. Examples:
%1$d videos moved, %2$d could not be moved
The files could not be moved
